title: Vegan Latkes with JUST Egg
author: Lenny Teytelman
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bas3iegn
materials: Peel and wash 2.5 pounds, russet potatoes .
Line a plate with paper towels.
Serve warm. Eat them with vegan sour cream.

steps.title: Prepare vegetables
steps.instruction: Cut up and grate the potatoes and 1 small yellow onion using a box grater or a food processor fitted with a grater disc.

steps.title: Mix batter
steps.instruction: In a large mixing bowl, combine the grated potatoes and onions with 1 teaspoon of salt, 0.25 cup of flour, and 0.25 cup of JUST Egg.

steps.title: Heat frying pan
steps.instruction: Cover the bottom of a frying pan with oil and heat to medium-high.

steps.title: Fry latkes
steps.instruction: Carefully place portions of the mixture into the hot oil.

substeps.instruction: Roll 1/4 cup of the fritter mixture into a ball.
Place the ball into the oil using a fish spatula or slotted spoon.

steps.title: Remove excess water
steps.instruction: Use a spoon to remove water from the surface of the batter by pressing the spoon down slightly and letting the liquid seep in.

steps.title: Flip and finish frying
steps.instruction: Flip the latkes, add more oil if necessary, and fry for another 3-5 minutes.

steps.title: Drain and serve
steps.instruction: Transfer the finished latkes to a paper towel-lined plate.
